items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Lert, to make us look like a big act, used to send over a good bus from Newark and from the Woodside. He put all our stuff in there and then just as we come out of the tunnel where you got to the airport, then we'd exchange buses and get this crooked bus.

ctx.x: what were the tours like and you said you took it with a grain of salt. Now you can go on with that.

Milt, as you know, you were with Cab Calloway, you, and you didn't have to stay at Mother's Lunch like we did, see, because we were still in a Lert's bus. You guys were on a train; we hadn't got to that plateau then and we had this crooked bus that went down the highway crooked. That's right, I have a picture I can show you coming out of Pittsburgh.
